dimensions.description: Satisfies explicit prompt and approved constraints.
Events follow from understandable causes and choices.
Motivation, behaviour, relationships and arc states are coherent.
Conflict and stakes create meaningful dramatic pressure.
Narrative progression and pacing fit the intended form.
Scenes/units cause meaningful narrative change rather than merely occupying space.
Canon, chronology, knowledge, beliefs, world rules and established state remain coherent.
Setups, reveals and payoffs are causally and temporally supported.
Voice/dialogue is controlled, specific and appropriate to the brief.
Output behaves like the requested narrative medium rather than a generic prose response.
Avoids generic filler and develops specific choices from the brief without unsupported sprawl.
Preserves approved decisions, avoids unnecessary regeneration and respects project boundaries.
